name: nuvc
description: Investor MCP: score and screen deals against your firm's saved mandate, screen funds as an LP, and find co-investors. Bound to your firm's NUVC account.
long_description: NUVC is the conviction layer for capital allocation. nuvc-mcp 2.0 is investor-only: score any startup or fund with an IC-ready verdict, save your firm's mandate once on your NUVC account so every score returns a two-way mandate fit, find co-investors, and run venture math and fund economics — all from Claude. Get an API key at https://nuvc.ai/api-platform/keys.

tools.name: nuvc_billing
tools.description: Read your current balance, quota, tool costs and available pack price; no purchase.

tools.name: nuvc_score
tools.description: Screen a pitch deck like an investment committee — a 0–10 score with strengths, gaps, and diligence questions; two-way fit against your firm mandate

tools.name: nuvc_match_investors
tools.description: Find co-investors and syndicate partners — a ranked, thesis-fit shortlist (a well-matched few beats a mass blast), each with a reason and brief

tools.name: nuvc_screen_fund
tools.description: Screen a VC fund across 6 LP-grade dimensions against your mandate

tools.name: nuvc_analyze
tools.description: Market, competitive, financial, or pitch-deck analysis

tools.name: nuvc_extract
tools.description: Extract structured fields from any pitch or business description

tools.name: nuvc_set_mandate
tools.description: Save your firm's mandate on the account that owns the key

tools.name: nuvc_venture_math
tools.description: Compute dilution, ownership, burn multiple, LTV/CAC, Rule of 40, IRR/MOIC vs VC thresholds

tools.name: nuvc_fund_economics
tools.description: Fund economics for LPs — fee drag, GP alignment, J-curve, portfolio construction

tools.name: nuvc_models
tools.description: List available scoring models and provider health

tools.name: nuvc_deal_brief
tools.description: The decision brief for a deal in your pipeline, read-only

tools.name: nuvc_precedent
tools.description: Your own decision history on similar deals, read-only

api_key.title: NUVC API Key
api_key.description: Your NUVC API key (starts with nuvc_). Get a free key — 2 free credits, no card — at https://nuvc.ai/api-platform/keys
